title: ComputeAllocation
description: One Session execution environment's CPU and memory limits.

allocation_id.description: Stable id for this Compute allocation fact.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

allocation_source.description: Who chose the allocation. Only `randomized` supports a causal comparison; every other source is observational.

cpu_millicores.description: CPU limit in millicores; 1000 is one CPU. Null means the sender reported no CPU limit, never zero.

memory_bytes.description: Memory limit in bytes. Null means the sender reported no memory limit, never zero.

occurred_at.description: When the allocation took effect, by the sender's clock. Derivations order a Session's allocations by it and never compare it with gateway-observed time.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.
